💥BIGBANG 2026 World  2026

YG Entertainment officially announced on March 4, 2026, that BIGBANG will launch a large-scale global tour in 2026 to celebrate their 20th anniversary. The tour, titled BIGSHOW: REBORN, will feature the trio G-Dragon, Taeyang, and Daesung. 

Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival
Dates: April 12 & 19, 2026
Location: Empire Polo Club, Indio, California, US

World Tour Stop: Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Reported Date: May 23, 2026

According to Korea Times and let await for YG Entertainment officially announcement
